name: skip-gate
description: Read a file and keep going when an expected marker is missing: the gate node uses on_failure=skip, so the run still succeeds and the node is reported as skipped (builtin-only, zero external dependencies)

inputs.name: marker
inputs.description: Substring that should appear in the file

outputs.name: logged
outputs.description: True when the final log node ran

params.message: continued past the marker gate (${nodes.read.outputs.size} bytes read from ${inputs.target})
